verdict.rationale: Recurly has no documented in-product natural-language command interface. It does ship a first-party Compass MCP server that lets AI agents such as Claude Desktop or Cursor work with Recurly's tools and APIs, which gives an official route to natural-language operation through an external agent. However, another description frames Compass mainly as documentation and API knowledge for development tools, so it is unclear whether it performs live account operations. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the product, documentation of which account actions can be run by natural-language command through Compass, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Recurly Compass MCP is a public MCP server that lets AI agents — such as Claude Desktop or Cursor — work directly with Recurly's tools and APIs, without complex setup.
Recurly Compass MCP connects your AI development tools directly to Recurly's documentation and API knowledge.
